Could that be you?

As a developer, you will build robust, scalable, and high-performance systems.

While frontend expertise is a must, full-stack experience is highly preferred (but not mandatory). Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

As a
****Software Engineer I (Full Stack)****

At The Alter Office, we build what comes next. We operate as an internal innovation lab, creating stealth products, new business bets, and high-leverage systems designed to unlock disproportionate value for us and our partner company ITW Consulting.
  
  
Our work is not centered around being a conventional service partner. Instead, we focus on building products and platforms that solve complex, strategic problems and create long-term advantage. Where needed, we have stepped in on critical opportunities beyond the usual scope, especially when speed, product thinking, and execution depth mattered most.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement.
  
  
Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, enjoys solving technical problems, and wants to grow beyond simply implementing tasks. You'll have opportunities to understand how backend systems connect to the product and gradually take ownership of larger parts of the platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain backend APIs and services for our ad marketplace, campaign management, and analytics platforms.
* Work with senior engineers to design and implement scalable backend solutions.
* Develop RESTful APIs and asynchronous backend workflows.
* Work with SQL databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL and NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB and Redis.
* Implement data models, database queries, caching, and basic performance optimizations.
* Contribute to backend infrastructure supporting analytics, attribution, and AI-powered platform features.
* Collaborate with product, frontend, backend, and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end features.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and basic security practices under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Write clean, maintainable, documented, and tested code.
* Use Git and participate in code reviews and team development practices.
* Learn and contribute to deploying backend services on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Work with Docker for containerizing backend services.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
* Help monitor, debug, and troubleshoot backend services in development and production environments.
* Explore event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as message brokers, WebSockets, or GraphQL where appropriate.

* 1–2 years of professional backend engineering experience, including relevant internship or project experience.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language, with the ability and willingness to adapt to other languages such as Node.js/JavaScript, Go, Python, and Java.
* Good understanding of RESTful API design and backend fundamentals.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming and how backend services communicate.
* Familiarity with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with at least one NoSQL database such as MongoDB or Redis is a plus.
* Good understanding of data modeling and writing SQL queries.
* Familiarity with Git and software development workflows.
* Good understanding of Docker and containerized applications.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
* Understanding of basic backend security concepts such as authentication, authorization, and secure API practices.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Good communication and willingness to collaborate with other engineers and product teams.
* Strong learning mindset and willingness to work with unfamiliar technologies.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

Learn more at betsol.com

**Job Description**
-------------------

BETSOL's team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources.

We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT.

Key responsibilities

Testing SAM publisher implementations

* Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output.
* Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover.
* Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not.
* Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts.
* Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line).
* Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances.

Building and running test automation

* Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines.
* Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight.
* Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks.
* Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers.

Quality process and reporting

* Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current.
* Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT.
* Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment.
* Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Required qualifications

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance.
* Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries.
* Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from.
* Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr.
* Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth.

Preferred qualifications

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based).
* Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports.
